07 / MINDSET & APPROACH

Understand deeply. Validate rigorously. Iterate purposefully.

01 · Understand

Clarify requirements, constraints, data quality, and the underlying engineering problem before selecting a model or architecture.

02 · Validate

Use baselines, cross-domain evaluation, error analysis, and failure-mode testing to make performance claims defensible.

03 · Iterate

Treat unsuccessful experiments as evidence, refine the hypothesis, and build toward systems that are reliable and useful.
